description: Build the frontend dashboard UI: a search input for Riot ID lookup, match history display with match cards showing champion icon, KDA, win/loss, and game duration. Use responsive Tailwind CSS and semantic HTML throughout.
steps: Replace app/page.tsx with the main dashboard page. Structure using semantic HTML: <header> for app title/branding, <main> for the search and results area, <footer> for attribution. Use a dark-themed design fitting the LoL aesthetic.

Create app/components/SearchForm.tsx - a client component ('use client') with a controlled input field that accepts 'GameName#Tag' format. Include: (a) An input with placeholder text showing the expected format, (b) A submit button, (c) Client-side validation that splits on '#' and validates both parts exist, (d) Loading state indicator while fetching, (e) Error message display area. Use responsive Tailwind classes (full width on mobile, constrained on larger screens).

Create app/components/MatchCard.tsx - a presentational component that displays a single match result. Include: (a) Champion icon (using next/image with the Data Dragon URL: https://ddragon.leagueoflegends.com/cdn/15.1.1/img/champion/{championName}.png), (b) Win/Loss indicator with green/red color coding, (c) KDA display (kills/deaths/assists and calculated ratio), (d) Game duration formatted as minutes:seconds, (e) Game mode label. Use semantic HTML (<article> for each card) and responsive grid layout.

Create app/components/MatchHistory.tsx - a component that renders a list of MatchCard components. Accept an array of MatchSummary objects. Show a message when no matches are found. Use a responsive grid/list layout (single column on mobile, multi-column on desktop).
Create app/components/ErrorDisplay.tsx - a component for showing user-friendly error messages (not found, rate limited, server error) with appropriate styling and suggested actions.
Create app/components/LoadingSpinner.tsx - a simple animated loading indicator component.

In the main page (app/page.tsx), wire everything together: SearchForm calls the /api/riot endpoint via fetch, passes results to MatchHistory, handles loading/error states with the respective components. Since this uses client interactivity, the page itself should be a client component or use a client component wrapper for the interactive parts.
Update app/layout.tsx metadata to reflect the app: title 'LoL Match History Tracker', description 'Track your League of Legends match performance'.
Update app/globals.css if needed for any custom styles not achievable with Tailwind utilities alone (minimal - prefer Tailwind classes).
acceptance_criteria: app/page.tsx renders a complete dashboard with semantic HTML (header, main, footer elements)
SearchForm component accepts Riot ID in 'GameName#Tag' format with client-side validation
MatchCard component displays champion icon, win/loss indicator, KDA, and game duration
MatchHistory component renders a responsive grid of match cards
ErrorDisplay component shows user-friendly error messages for different error types
LoadingSpinner component provides visual feedback during API calls
All components use responsive Tailwind CSS classes (mobile-first approach)
All layout sections use semantic HTML elements (header, main, nav, article, section, footer)
The page handles the full flow: input -> fetch -> display results or errors
Champion icons use next/image with the ddragon.leagueoflegends.com domain configured in next.config.ts
